setting.target: Local URL to test. No requests are sent until you run a command.
setting.remote: Permit non-loopback URLs; each remote test also requires explicit confirmation.
setting.k6Path: Path to locally installed Grafana k6 executable.
setting.vus: Hard ceiling on concurrent virtual users (1–100).
setting.goProfilerOrigin: Local Go net/http/pprof origin (literal 127.0.0.1 or [::1]). Profiles are never collected automatically.
setting.sloP95: Optional maximum P95 latency in milliseconds; 0 disables SLO evaluation.
setting.maxRequests: Hard request budget per local test. Does not certify capacity (100–100000).
command.sarif: Export Verified Go Race Evidence as SARIF
